typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Load 'Cabinet Grotesk' via Fontshare CDN and 'IBM Plex Sans' via Google Fonts. Keep headings sharp and clinical.

colors.guidelines: Clinical whites and medical blues. Use #0B3B60 for strong contrast areas and #0066FF for interactive accents (buttons, links). No generic full-screen gradients. Use pure white surfaces with 1px slate-200 borders.

visual_enhancers.guidelines: Avoid transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Use glassmorphism (white/80 + blur) for sticky headers.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-12, p-16, p-24 for sections. Components need internal padding (p-8).
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For features: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Mix spans: col-span-2 row-span-2 for hero feature, col-span-1 for stats.

page_blueprints.home: Hero (text reveal) -> Marquee -> Bento Features Grid -> Manifesto -> CTA
page_blueprints.features: Deep dive feature rows with alternating text/image layout, high padding.
page_blueprints.screenshots: Gallery grid of mobile device mockups (use CSS frames) containing placeholder screenshots.
page_blueprints.privacy: Max-width text container (max-w-3xl), rich typography, big serif or crisp sans numbers.
page_blueprints.support: Visual contact form (grid-cols-2) and FAQ accordion (using native <details> and <summary> or vanilla JS).

motion.kinetic_hero: Line-by-line mask reveal on load using CSS animations (transform translateY, opacity) or vanilla JS IntersectionObserver.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use IntersectionObserver to toggle an '.is-visible' class that translates Y from 20px to 0 and fades opacity from 0 to 1.
motion.marquee: Slow CSS keyframe animation for continuous horizontal scroll of editorial text.
motion.smooth_scroll: Include Lenis smooth scroll via CDN (`<script src="https://unpkg.com/@studio-freight/lenis@1.0.42/dist/lenis.min.js"></script>`).

image_urls.description: Doctor showing scan to patient on tablet

media.app_screenshots: Use pure CSS mobile frames or stylized div boxes with a dark placeholder background and centered icon for the 'mobile app screenshots later' requirement. DO NOT leave them completely blank, add an icon or a placeholder medical graphic.

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure high contrast (APCA). Provide aria-labels for buttons and interactive elements. Use semantic HTML5 elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use React, Vue, or any build step. Create pure HTML files (`index.html`, `features.html`, `screenshots.html`, `privacy.html`, `support.html`) in the `/app` root.

Use Tailwind CSS via CDN: `<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>` and configure the theme inside `<script>tailwind.config = { theme: { extend: { colors: { primary: '#0B3B60', accent: '#0066FF' }, fontFamily: { sans: ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'], display: ['Cabinet Grotesk', 'sans-serif'] } } } }</script>`.
Use Phosphor icons via CDN (`<script src="https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web"></script>`) or FontAwesome.
Create a separate `styles.css` for custom keyframes (marquee, reveals) and `script.js` for IntersectionObserver and Lenis setup. Link them in all HTML files.
Ensure the header is present on all pages and is sticky using `fixed top-0 w-full z-50` with glassmorphism.
For the screenshots placeholder, use `div` elements styled like mobile phones (rounded-3xl border-8 border-slate-800 aspect-[9/19] bg-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center).
Keep Javascript entirely vanilla in `script.js`. Do not attempt to use JSX.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
